main_text.p: tuit, ut quicquid aqua lambendo abstulerit, id possessor amittat. Et Põponius L. uerbis legis, 120. De uerb. sig. Sed id interpretatione coagusta[?]tum est, uel legum, uel auctoritate iura constituentium.

Atque haec quidem hactenus. Nunc quod optimum Iuris interpretandi genus esse arbitremur, qua de re nos postremo loco explicaturos dicebamus, breuiter differendum uidetur. page.notes: The small "»" marks at the start of many lines are not transcribed; they look like line-start marks, not words. The handwritten ink annotation in the left margin ("De optimo genere iuris interpretandi" or similar) is manuscript, not printed, so it is left out. The running head at the top is decorated and not readable with certainty. "sig." is read from "fig."; the long s is written as plain s per the rules. "coagusta[?]tum" is uncertain, and "Triplicē" with its tilde is uncertain.
